title: Electrical map
description: A direct electrical map with explicit power returns, the shared ground reference, and internal motor A/B links. Functions are shown independently of connector-face geometry.

title: Photo-guided map
description: A port locator made from the actual controller photograph beside the electrical map. Use full-screen zoom to inspect the smaller connection details.

title: Power first, then data
description: First understand motor power and common return; then inspect the RS485 daisy-chain with completed power shown in gray. Perform all wiring with power off.

title: Connector landmarks
description: A simplified component-side controller drawing with the correct J1/J2/J3/J5 placement and exactly eight J2 contacts. Motor pigtail functions are detached keys, not connector-face pin positions.

title: Natural-material illustration
description: Natural black-and-silver motor artwork with precisely drawn connections and larger labels. The isolated motor art has no electrical wire endpoints; the dashed keys define pigtail functions.

title: Restrained cartoon illustration
description: A more diagrammatic motor treatment paired with the same checked wiring. Compare its small-size clarity against the natural-material version. The function keys are separate from connector faces.
